newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Boston widens bank coverage.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Boston widens bank coverage.

text.p: -- Credit Suisse First Boston said it expanded its bank coverage with the hiring of analysts Michael Mayo and Sean Ryan from Lehman Bros. Analysts Bradley Ball and Eric Rothmann remain at CS First Boston.
-- The switch involved CS First Boston starting research coverage of several of the banks tracked by Mayo.
-- First Tennessee National Corp, Summit Bancorp and First Commerce Corp were started as strong buys.
CS First Boston started Crestar Financial Corp, Southern National Corp, First of America Bank Corp, Imperial Bancorp and Regions Financial Corp with buy ratings.
Hibernia Corp was started with a hold rating.
Ball said Mayo will lead the regional coverage. Ball will focus on money center banks and west coat regionals. Ryan will focus on east coast regionals.
Lehman Bros, a unit of Lehman Bros Holdings Inc, was not immediately available for comment.
